+module

+public import Sheaf.Algebra.Homology.HomTensorDegreewise
+public import WeilConjectures.Algebra.Category.ModuleCat.Sheaf.MonoidalClosed
+
+@[expose] public section
+set_option autoImplicit false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false
+set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency.types false
+noncomputable section
+universe u
+open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.MonoidalCategory Opposite
+namespace SheafOfModules
+
+variable {C : Type u} [Category.{u} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
+  [J.HasSheafCompose (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})]
+  (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u})
+  [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{u}] [HasWeakSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{u}]
+
+set_option hygiene false in
+local notation "Mod" => SheafOfModules.{u}
+  ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R)
+
+private lemma sectionMap_braiding (A B : Mod) :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    letI := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory R
+    homTensorSectionMap R A B ≫ (β_ A B).hom.val =
+      (β_ A.val B.val).hom ≫ homTensorSectionMap R B A := by
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  let := SheafOfModules.symmetricCategory R
+  let := SheafOfModules.sheafificationMonoidal R
+  let := SheafOfModules.sheafificationBraided R
+  let S := PresheafOfModules.sheafification
+    (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).obj)
+  have hc : (β_ A B).hom ≫ (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification B A).hom =
+      (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).hom ≫
+        S.map (β_ A.val B.val).hom := by
+    simp only [SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification, Iso.trans_hom, Iso.symm_hom,
+      tensorIso_inv, Iso.app_inv, asIso_inv, Functor.Monoidal.μIso_hom]
+    rw [← Category.assoc, ← BraidedCategory.braiding_naturality, Category.assoc,
+      Category.assoc]
+    exact congrArg (_ ≫ ·) (Functor.LaxBraided.braided (F := S) A.val B.val).symm
+  have hi : (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).inv ≫ (β_ A B).hom =
+      S.map (β_ A.val B.val).hom ≫
+        (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification B A).inv := by
+    rw [Iso.inv_comp_eq, ← Category.assoc, ← hc, Category.assoc,
+      Iso.hom_inv_id, Category.comp_id]
+  unfold homTensorSectionMap
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← SheafOfModules.comp_val, hi]
+  rw [← Category.assoc]
+  exact congrArg (fun f ↦ f ≫ (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification B A).inv.val)
+    ((PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
+      (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).obj)).unit.naturality
+        (β_ A.val B.val).hom).symm
+
+private lemma sectionMap_uncurry (A B N : Mod)
+    (ψ : B ⟶ SheafOfModules.homObj (R := R) A N) :
+    letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+    homTensorSectionMap R A B ≫
+        ((SheafOfModules.tensorHomEquiv A B N).symm ψ).val =
+      (PresheafOfModules.homObjEquiv A.val B.val N.val).symm ψ.val := by
+  let := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R
+  unfold homTensorSectionMap
+  change (_ ≫ (SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).inv.val) ≫
+      ((SheafOfModules.tensorObjIsoSheafification A B).hom ≫ _).val = _
+  simp only [Category.assoc, ← SheafOfModules.comp_val, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]
+  exact (PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction
+    (𝟙 ((sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R).obj)).homEquiv
+      (A.val ⊗ B.val) N |>.apply_symm_apply _
+
